environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed in namespace 'prod-api' with Istio sidecar. Istio PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mTLS for the mesh. An AuthorizationPolicy named 'deny-external-audit' is applied at mesh level (root namespace istio-system) with a DENY action matching requests where source.namespace is NOT in ['prod-api', 'monitoring'] AND the operation paths include '/api/v1/audit'. A second workload-scoped AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-ingress-only' on the prod-api namespace uses an ALLOW action requiring source.principal to match 'cluster.local/ns/istio-system/sa/istio-ingressgateway-service-account' for paths ['/api/v1/login', '/api/v1/search']. The /api/v1/audit endpoint is only reachable from pods in 'monitoring' namespace with service account 'sa-audit-collector'. External requests through the IngressGateway can only reach /login and /search. The Fluentd log parser uses a strict regex pattern that drops log lines not matching the expected structured format (field=value pairs without newlines), effectively neutralizing injected log entries that attempt CRLF or multi-line injection into the SIEM.

config.network_policy: default-deny ingress with explicit allow from istio-system
